extension.description: Monitor your homelab from Kodi. View network devices, service health, internet connectivity and outages, VPN status, speed test history, DDNS status, CVE threat feed, system stats, and audit events — all pulled live from your Claudette server. Full action support: trigger scans, deep scans, service refreshes, speed tests, and DDNS updates directly from the Kodi interface.
extension.disclaimer: Requires a running Claudette server on your network. Configure the server URL in addon settings.
